tools.name: search_facts
tools.description: Search current official U.S. figures (tax limits, Social Security, Medicare, postage, poverty guidelines). Returns answers with official source links.

tools.name: get_fact
tools.description: Get one official figure by id, with details, effective date, previous value and official source.

tools.name: list_facts
tools.description: List all available official figures. Optional category: retirement, tax, social-security, health, everyday.

tools.name: loan_payment
tools.description: Monthly payment, total paid and total interest for a fixed-rate loan or mortgage (standard amortization).

tools.name: compound_interest
tools.description: Future value of savings with compound interest and optional monthly contributions (added at month end).

tools.name: percent_change
tools.description: Percent change from one value to another.

tools.name: percent_of
tools.description: What is X percent of Y.

tools.name: unit_convert
tools.description: Convert length, mass, volume (US units), area, speed, data size or temperature (c, f, k).

tools.name: date_difference
tools.description: Days between two dates (YYYY-MM-DD), plus weeks and calendar months.

tools.name: add_days
tools.description: Add (or subtract) days to a date. Returns the date and weekday.

tools.name: poverty_level_percent
tools.description: Household income as a percent of the 2026 HHS federal poverty guideline.

tools.name: payroll_tax_2027
tools.description: Employee Social Security (6.2% up to $192,300) and Medicare (1.45%) tax on 2027 wages. Excludes the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax.

tools.name: retirement_max_2027
tools.description: Maximum 2027 employee 401(k)/403(b)/457 deferral and IRA contribution for a given age.
